title: Scale Ratio Calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute the scale ratio (100) from the given actual and image heights.

title: Blur Displacement Scaling
description: Essential: Student must apply the scale ratio to convert the measured blur width to the actual displacement (0.2 m).

title: Average Velocity Computation
description: Important: Student must correctly calculate average speed using displacement and exposure time (12 m/s).

title: Velocity Interpretation
description: Important: Student must recognize that the average speed approximates the instantaneous speed during the short exposure.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units throughout calculations and includes units in final answers.

title: Incorrect Scale Application
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly applies the scale ratio (e.g., dividing instead of multiplying) when converting blur width.

title: Time Misuse
description: Pitfall: Student uses an incorrect time value (e.g., 1/100 s from the race distance) instead of the given exposure time.
